{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Medevac''''' was a group of three [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] that served in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
They transferred wounded from the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|evacuation]] of [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]] during [[Operation Strike Fear]] to the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']].

The transfer was [[Skirmish near Brigia|interrupted]] by the arrival of the Imperial Nebulon-B frigate [[Warspite (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Warspite'']] which began launching [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]]. The actions of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], and particularly [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], protected the transfer and all Rebel ships escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

===Legacy===
A [[Redemption scenario|simulation]] based on that event would later be part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] training program. When [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] reformed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], this test was used as one of the benchmarks for candidates to enter the squadron.
